page.overview:
Who is Count di Argentisso of Scozzese?

Count di Argentisso of Scozzese was the ruler of the city-state of Scozzese, a small, Tilean city-state allied with Pavona in the 24th century IC.

The Count di Argentisso was a fascinating man. He travelled widely to Araby and beyond, opening up new and highly lucrative trade routes into the hitherto unknown territories of the Southlands. He was also the only man trusted by both sides in the Fifth Remas-Luccini War and succeeded in brokering a peace settlement, bringing to an end almost three centuries of unremitting hostility between the two great Tilean trading rivals.

The count and his wife, the Contessa Eleanora Daria di Argentisso, fell victim to an outbreak of the Red Pox, and their line died out with them.

The count's surname implies that his family originated in the city of Argentisso, or that Argentisso was the name of his father.
